goal: Validate the governed AID client end to end with DeepSeek V4-Pro as the planning, review, and final provider.
acceptance_criteria: All local gates and provider routing remain explicit and traceable.
Every DeepSeek planner, reviewer, and final artifact is bound to provider deepseek, model deepseek-v4-pro, interface deepseek-anthropic-api, and the same AID run.
Archon v0.5.0 workflow validation and the deterministic contract probe remain ready without Claude execution.
The delivery workflow produces real PR, CI, manifest, review, final-gate, and rollback evidence; merge, deploy, secrets, billing, and branch protection remain human-controlled.

tasks.title: Preserve the DeepSeek V4-Pro provider and provenance chain
acceptance_criteria: DeepSeek provider probe is PASS or an explicitly recorded degraded fallback.
S1/S8/S10 provenance records contain deepseek-v4-pro and no Claude provider identity.
No credential is written to repository files, logs, manifests, or task artifacts.
risks: Provider fallback or model drift can invalidate the required provenance contract.
A credential or raw response can leak into evidence if redaction boundaries regress.

tasks.title: Run governed Archon compatibility and application workflow checks
acceptance_criteria: Pinned Archon v0.5.0 version and SHA-256 checks pass.
All required workflows are discovered and validate successfully.
Deterministic contract probe returns ai-delivery-archon-probe/v1 with ok=true.
The opencode compatibility bridge remains bound to the governed DeepSeek launcher and does not admit legacy credentials.
risks: Archon schema/provider drift can silently route a logical role to the wrong executable.
Workflow validation alone cannot prove GitHub PR or CI state.

tasks.title: Complete the evidence-backed delivery handoff without autonomous production mutation
acceptance_criteria: S3 through S7 produce a bound branch/worktree, Codex plan, read-only exploration proof, implementation gates, manifest, rollback, and real CI evidence.
DeepSeek reviewer and final artifacts are imported only from the governed model-artifacts directory and are tied to real evidence hashes.
Repeated blockers route to human decision and production status remains NO_GO until real external and human evidence is present.
risks: Missing GitHub authentication, PR/CI, CODEOWNERS, or branch-protection evidence must stop the run.
A green local check must not be promoted to production GO without external evidence and owner authorization.

human_boundaries: No secrets, billing, branch-protection, or production-data mutation.
